category: confidential inference API, one-time free token quota

free_tier.stated: a one-time free quota of 5 million tokens for new organizations; after it is exhausted, pay-as-you-go or Enterprise is required; rate limits are 200,000 prompt tokens/min, 20,000 completion tokens/min, 500,000 cached prompt tokens/min and 40 requests/min

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: the Privatemode SDK, a local proxy (OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible) at localhost:8080, a desktop proxy app and a browser web app
chaining: pairs with OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible agents through the local proxy; the scarce link is a one-time quota that may need a card to unlock

limits.value: one-time Initial Token Quota of 5,000,000 tokens; HTTP 402 once exhausted
200,000 prompt tokens/min, 20,000 completion tokens/min, 500,000 cached prompt tokens/min, 100 audio min/min, 40 requests/min

binding_note: the 5,000,000-token one-time quota is finite and ends the free tier, so it binds before the per-minute rate

identity_cost.detail: an account and API key are set up in the portal; the rate-limits page says a payment card may be needed to unlock the initial quota before inference requests

reliability_note: the free tier is a trial; after the quota is exhausted the API returns HTTP 402 until pay-as-you-go is enabled

evidence.proved: new organizations get a one-time 5 million token free quota
evidence.quote: Privatemode uses usage-based pricing. New organizations receive a one-time free quota of 5 million tokens.

evidence.proved: a card may be needed to unlock the initial quota, after which HTTP 402 is returned
evidence.quote: You may need to add a payment card in the portal to unlock this quota before making inference requests.

notes: 5M one-time tokens is an expiring-style trial quota rather than a standing tier, and the card requirement for unlock is stated in the rate-limits page.
